candidates.description: This vector represents adjectives and roots denoting importance, distinction, or specificity.
This vector represents common Spanish nouns, predominantly masculine, referring to abstract or concrete entities, items, and categories.
This vector represents descriptive adjectives denoting the context, scale, or environment of human activity and existence.
These tokens represent nominal and adjectival suffixes or root endings common in Romance languages like Spanish and Portuguese.
This feature vector represents linguistic tokens related to the root concept of activity, actuation, or being active across different languages and grammatical forms.
This feature activates for terms related to travel, tourism, and leisure, along with multilingual and fragmented subwords.
This feature vector represents Spanish noun suffixes related to actions, states, or results ending in '-ión' and its grammatical variants.
This feature represents prefixes and root words commonly found in socio-political, academic, and economic terminology across multiple languages.
This vector activates for terms and roots associated with conflict, disease states, and opposition.
This feature vector activates common Spanish verbal stems and prefixes.
